info.title: lucy API
info.description: One typed API behind every lucy surface: JSON-RPC 2.0, one request per POST to /rpc/v1, over the daemon's unix socket (and HTTPS for remote surfaces, from m1). See ADR D10.

methods.name: rpc.discover
methods.summary: The API's OpenRPC document: every method, its params, result and errors.

methods.name: hello
methods.summary: Negotiate the API version and learn the caller's identity, scopes and the methods it may call.

params.name: client
params.description: The calling surface, for example lucy-cli.

params.name: client_version
params.description: The calling surface's version.

params.name: api_versions
params.description: API major versions the client speaks.

api_version.description: The API version chosen: the highest both sides speak.

caller.description: Who the daemon thinks is calling.

actor.description: The caller's name in the event log.

device.description: local for the socket; a paired device's id remotely.

pid.description: The peer's process id, when the OS reports it.

scopes.description: The scopes granted to this caller.

transport.description: unix, or https once remote control lands.

uid.description: The peer's user id on the unix socket.

methods.description: The methods this caller's scopes allow.

methods.name: health
methods.summary: Liveness: the daemon is up and its event store answers.

status.description: ok when the daemon and its event store answer.

methods.name: status.get
methods.summary: The daemon's version, uptime and event log head.

event_head.description: Sequence number of the last event in the log; 0 when empty.

refused_connections.description: Socket connections refused since start (another user, or no peer credentials).

methods.name: events.list
methods.summary: Events from the log after a sequence number, oldest first.

params.name: after_seq
params.description: Return events with a sequence number greater than this; 0 starts at the beginning.

params.name: limit
params.description: At most this many events; 0 means 100.

payload.description: The typed payload as stored; events never carry secrets.

stream.description: The stream the event belongs to.

head.description: The log's head when the page was read.

more.description: Whether events after this page existed when it was read.

next.description: Pass as after_seq to read the next page.

methods.name: daemon.shutdown
methods.summary: Stop the daemon gracefully after answering.

stopping.description: True: the daemon stops after this response.

methods.name: policy.evaluate
methods.summary: Ask the policy engine to decide an action; the decision is recorded before it is returned.

params.name: kind
params.description: The action: read, write, merge, delete, force_push, branch_delete, history_rewrite, credential_use, exec, fetch or container.

params.name: org
params.description: The org the target belongs to.

params.name: project
params.description: The project (repository), when the action has one.

params.name: resource
params.description: What the action is on: a PR (pr/12), an absolute path, a branch or a credential name.

params.name: inputs
params.description: What the request is based on, each with its source. The caller's own request is added as an owner input.

ref.description: A reference to the input: an event, URL or comment id. Never the text itself.

source.description: owner, config, daemon, task, agent, tool_output, repo_content, issue, pr_body, pr_comment, web or email.

action_sha256.description: The digest of the action (actor, kind, target) an approval must name.

approvals_used.description: The approval decisions a clearance rested on, in the order the rules used them (a fixed-list owner approval before a relayed client confirmation); empty when denied or holding.

facts_sha256.description: The digest of the facts the approver saw (a merge's head SHA, base ref and base SHA; a delete's resolved path; a credential's scope; the default branch for force-push, branch delete and history rewrite) an approval must also name; an approval for the same action under other facts is denied.

id.description: The decision's position in the policy stream; pass as after to page.

outcome.description: cleared, denied or holding (waiting on the owner).

reason.description: Why, in one line. {owner} stands for the owner; render it with the configured display title.

resource.description: The target resource. A shell command, URL or search (exec, fetch) is redacted and capped, followed by sha256:<hex> of the original.

ruleset_sha256.description: The SHA-256 of that rule set.

ruleset_version.description: The version of the rule set that decided.

seq.description: The decision event's position in the whole log.

tainted.description: Whether any input came from an untrusted source.

methods.name: policy.decisions
methods.summary: Recorded policy decisions, oldest first.

params.name: after
params.description: Return decisions with an id greater than this; 0 starts at the beginning.

params.name: limit
params.description: At most this many decisions; 0 means 100.

action_sha256.description: The digest of the action (actor, kind, target) an approval must name.

approvals_used.description: The approval decisions a clearance rested on, in the order the rules used them (a fixed-list owner approval before a relayed client confirmation); empty when denied or holding.

facts_sha256.description: The digest of the facts the approver saw (a merge's head SHA, base ref and base SHA; a delete's resolved path; a credential's scope; the default branch for force-push, branch delete and history rewrite) an approval must also name; an approval for the same action under other facts is denied.

id.description: The decision's position in the policy stream; pass as after to page.

outcome.description: cleared, denied or holding (waiting on the owner).

reason.description: Why, in one line. {owner} stands for the owner; render it with the configured display title.

resource.description: The target resource. A shell command, URL or search (exec, fetch) is redacted and capped, followed by sha256:<hex> of the original.

ruleset_sha256.description: The SHA-256 of that rule set.

ruleset_version.description: The version of the rule set that decided.

seq.description: The decision event's position in the whole log.

tainted.description: Whether any input came from an untrusted source.

more.description: Whether decisions after this page existed when it was read.

next.description: Pass as after to read the next page.

methods.name: resources.list
methods.summary: The config resources the daemon loaded and their status, as conditions.

params.name: offset
params.description: Skip this many resources; 0 starts at the beginning.

params.name: limit
params.description: At most this many resources; 0 means 100.

more.description: Whether resources after this page existed when it was read.

next.description: Pass as offset to read the next page.

refused.description: Files and documents the latest load refused that name no resource: a parse error, a missing or invalid kind, name or namespace, or a duplicate. On the first page (offset 0) only; empty on the others.

last_transition_time.description: When the status last changed, RFC 3339 UTC.

message.description: What a person needs to know.

reason.description: A machine-readable reason, for example SchemaViolation.
Why it was refused, the Valid condition's reason, for example MissingNamespace.

source.description: The file it came from, relative to the config directory, and the document's position in it.

refused_truncated.description: Refusals the latest load left out of refused, beyond the 32 it records.

resources.description: The resources and their current status.

last_transition_time.description: When the status last changed, RFC 3339 UTC.

message.description: What a person needs to know.

reason.description: A machine-readable reason, for example SchemaViolation.

name.description: The resource's name, unique per namespace and kind.

namespace.description: The airspace (org) the resource belongs to.

source.description: The file it came from, relative to the config directory, and the document's position in it.

spec_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical spec, defaults applied; empty when the resource was refused.

methods.name: audit.verify
methods.summary: Verify the audit hash chain against the event log.

broken_at_seq.description: The event whose entry failed, when broken.

entries.description: Entries verified; when broken, the entries before the break.

head.description: The last entry's hash, when verified.

reason.description: Why the chain is broken, when it is.

verified.description: True when every entry hashes correctly, links to the one before it and matches its event.

methods.name: runner.queued
methods.summary: How many runs wait for a runner placed at placement. A runner polls this and leases only when it is not zero, so an idle runner adds nothing to the log. A runner placed in a container is not counted the runs of an org whose container is being restarted or stopped.

params.name: placement
params.description: The asking runner's placement: host (this machine; the default) or container (an org's container).

methods.name: runner.lease
methods.summary: Lease the oldest queued run under a new fencing token. A runner placed in a container is never leased a run whose org's container is being restarted or stopped; when every queued run is such a run, it is refused with sandbox_busy and leases again later.

params.name: runner
params.description: The runner's id: 1-63 of a-z, 0-9, '.', '_' and '-', starting with a letter or digit.

params.name: placement
params.description: host (this machine; the default) or container (an org's container).

params.name: ttl_seconds
params.description: The lease's life; 0 means 60, and values below 5 mean 5.

leased.description: False when no run was queued; run is then empty.

capability.description: The run's capability token for its org's gateway: valid only while this lease is held, for the org's gateway routes, until it expires (five minutes, renewed by each heartbeat) or is revoked. lucy keeps only its digest; give it to nothing but the run's own gateway calls.

expires_at.description: When the lease expires unless renewed, UTC.

fence.description: The fencing token: name it on every heartbeat and finish. Fences only grow; an old one is refused.

flight.description: The flight (task) the run is for.

generation.description: The flight's Pilot generation: 1, then +1 for each replacement.

goal.description: What the run is for. Data for the work, never instructions to lucy.

org.description: The org (airspace) the run belongs to.

run.description: The run's id; a Pilot run is <flight>#<generation>.

methods.name: runner.heartbeat
methods.summary: Renew a lease and record the run's newly streamed events, in one transaction.

params.name: runner
params.description: The runner holding the lease.

params.name: run
params.description: The leased run.

params.name: fence
params.description: The lease's fencing token.

params.name: ttl_seconds
params.description: The renewed life; 0 means 60, and values below 5 mean 5.

params.name: events
params.description: The run's new events, numbered from 1 without gaps; a resent event is skipped.

hook.description: The harness lifecycle hook that fired: required on a hook event, refused on any other. SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse, PostToolUse, Notification, Stop, SubagentStop, PreCompact or SessionEnd.

question.description: The question's id: required on an asking event and the same on every repeat of the question, refused on any other. An asking event for an answered question is recorded as activity.

seq.description: The event's number in its run, from 1.

text.description: The event's text: a line of output, a summary, or the question. Untrusted.

params.name: acked
params.description: The id of the question whose answer, from an earlier heartbeat's result, the runner gave its work. Until it is acknowledged the answer comes again in every result. An id the owner did not answer under this lease is ignored.

accepted.description: The highest event number recorded for the run.

answer.description: The owner's answer to the run's question, relayed by the Tower. Give it to the work once, then acknowledge it; it comes again in every result until acknowledged.

asking.description: The run's last recorded event is a question still waiting on an answer. False with no answer after the runner asked means the answer was lost: ask again.

capability.description: The run's fresh capability token for its org's gateway, replacing the one before, which is revoked: keep only the newest, in memory. Absent when the run has none, is stopping, or its lease is past the four-hour limit.

question.description: With answer: the id of the question it answers, to send back as acked.

stop.description: The Tower asked for the run to stop: stop the work and finish the run as stopped.

methods.name: runner.finish
methods.summary: Finish a leased run with its outcome.

params.name: runner
params.description: The runner holding the lease.

params.name: run
params.description: The leased run.

params.name: fence
params.description: The lease's fencing token.

params.name: outcome
params.description: done, failed, stopped or lost.

params.name: pr
params.description: When done: the pull request the work opened.

params.name: reason
params.description: When not done: why. Untrusted.

state.description: The run's final state: done, failed, stopped or lost.

methods.name: runner.permit
methods.summary: Ask the policy engine whether a leased run's Pilot may use a prompted file tool; the decision is recorded before it is returned.

params.name: runner
params.description: The runner holding the lease.

params.name: run
params.description: The leased run.

params.name: fence
params.description: The lease's fencing token.

params.name: tool
params.description: The prompted tool's name, as the harness gave it. Untrusted.

params.name: kind
params.description: read, write, exec or fetch.

params.name: resource
params.description: For a read or write, the absolute path inside the run's directory, empty when the tool names none; for an exec, the shell command; for a fetch, the URL or search. Untrusted text: the engine decides on it as written, and an exec or fetch is recorded redacted, with its SHA-256.

outcome.description: cleared, denied or holding. Only cleared lets the tool run.

methods.name: questions.list
methods.summary: The Pilots' open questions, as the Tower records them: each flight that is asking, oldest first.

questions.description: Every flight that is asking, oldest question first; empty when none is.

question.description: The Pilot's question, as the Tower recorded it. Untrusted.

since.description: When the flight started asking, UTC.

methods.name: questions.answer
methods.summary: Answer a flight's open question; the Tower relays the answer to its Pilot and records only its digest.

params.name: flight
params.description: The flight that is asking.

params.name: answer
params.description: The owner's answer. It reaches the Pilot through the Tower; the log keeps only its digest.

state.description: The flight's state after the answer, normally flying.

methods.name: runs.list
methods.summary: Runs and their leases, in the order they were queued.

params.name: after
params.description: Return runs queued after this position; 0 starts at the beginning.

params.name: limit
params.description: At most this many runs; 0 means 100.

more.description: Whether runs after this page existed when it was read.

next.description: Pass as after to read the next page.

runs.description: The runs, in the order they were queued.

activity.description: When the run last did something, UTC.

asking.description: The run's last event was a question.

expires_at.description: When leased: the lease's expiry, UTC.

fence.description: The current or last lease's fencing token.

flight.description: The flight the run is for.

position.description: The run's place in the queue; pass as after to page.

reason.description: When failed, stopped or lost: why. Untrusted.

runner.description: The runner that holds or held it.

state.description: queued, leased, done, failed, stopped or lost.

methods.name: sandbox.held
methods.summary: Operations on an org's container that wait on the owner: each would stop the sessions live in it, oldest first.

held.description: Every container operation that waits on the owner, oldest first; empty when none does.

decision.description: The policy decision that waits; a confirmation names it.

live_sessions.description: The runs live in the container, which the operation would stop.

op.description: up, restart or down: each stops the work running in the container.

org.description: The org whose container it is.

outcome.description: holding, or denied when an earlier confirmation lapsed because the live sessions changed.

methods.name: sandbox.confirm
methods.summary: Confirm stopping the live sessions a waiting container operation names; the daemon's next request for it is then cleared, while those sessions are unchanged.

params.name: org
params.description: The org whose container it is.

params.name: op
params.description: up, restart or down.

params.name: decision
params.description: The waiting decision, as sandbox.held shows it. A newer request replaces it, and a confirmation of the old one is refused.

approval.description: The confirmation's own decision id, which the cleared request will name.

methods.name: gateway.routes
methods.summary: An org's credential gateway routes, as the daemon loaded them from the org's SecretStore binding. No credential is in them.

params.name: org
params.description: The org.

routes.description: Its routes, by name; empty when the org has no gateway binding.

allow.description: What a worker may ask for.

path.description: A clean absolute path prefix that ends at a segment.

credential.description: The credential's name in the org's vault; never its value.

header.description: The header the credential goes in; Authorization when empty.

name.description: What a worker calls it by: the first path element.

prefix.description: Put before the credential in the header.

scope.description: What the credential grants, as policy records it.

methods.name: gateway.use
methods.summary: Decide an org gateway's use of a route's credential through the policy engine, and record the decision and the request, before the gateway forwards it.

params.name: org
params.description: The org.

params.name: route
params.description: The route, which must be in the daemon's config for the org.

params.name: method
params.description: The worker's HTTP method.

params.name: path
params.description: The path the worker sent, in the form the gateway records it: redacted, capped, with the SHA-256 of the whole path.

params.name: upstream
params.description: The host the gateway will call, which must be the route's.

params.name: capability
params.description: The capability token the worker presented. The daemon verifies it first and records only its id; a request without a valid one is refused.

cleared.description: Whether the gateway may forward the request with the credential.

methods.name: gateway.verify
methods.summary: Check the capability token a request to an org's gateway carries, before the gateway reads any credential, and record a refusal as gateway.denied.

params.name: org
params.description: The org.

params.name: route
params.description: The route, which must be in the daemon's config for the org.

params.name: method
params.description: The worker's HTTP method.

params.name: path
params.description: The path the worker sent, in the form the gateway records it: redacted, capped, with the SHA-256 of the whole path.

params.name: upstream
params.description: The host the gateway will call, which must be the route's.

params.name: capability
params.description: The capability token the worker presented. The daemon verifies it first and records only its id; a request without a valid one is refused.

verified.description: Whether the capability is valid for the org, the route and a run still leased under it. False is recorded as gateway.denied; forward nothing.

methods.name: gateway.deny
methods.summary: Record a request an org's gateway refused before any credential was involved.

params.name: org
params.description: The org.

params.name: route
params.description: The route, when the request named a known one.

params.name: method
params.description: The worker's HTTP method.

params.name: path
params.description: The path the worker sent, in the form the gateway records it: redacted, capped, with the SHA-256 of the whole path.

params.name: reason
params.description: Why it was refused.

recorded.description: Always true: an unrecorded request is an error.

methods.name: gateway.complete
methods.summary: Record how a forwarded gateway request ended.

params.name: org
params.description: The org.

params.name: decision
params.description: The decision it was forwarded on.

params.name: status
params.description: The upstream's HTTP status.

params.name: scrubbed
params.description: How many echoed copies of the credential were scrubbed from the answer.

params.name: error
params.description: Why it failed, when it did.

recorded.description: Always true: an unrecorded request is an error.

methods.name: capabilities.list
methods.summary: The capability tokens issued to runs, by id, never the tokens: newest first, only those not yet expired unless all.

params.name: all
params.description: Include capabilities past their expiry.

capabilities.description: Newest first; empty when there are none.

expires.description: When it expires at the latest, UTC; the run's lease ends it sooner.

fence.description: The lease it is bound to.

id.description: The first 16 hex digits of the token's SHA-256.

routes.description: The gateway routes it may use.

run.description: The run it was issued to.

methods.name: capability.revoke
methods.summary: Revoke a capability token by its id: the gateway refuses it from then on.

params.name: id
params.description: The capability's id, as capabilities.list shows it.

params.name: reason
params.description: Why, for the record.

expires.description: When it expires at the latest, UTC; the run's lease ends it sooner.

fence.description: The lease it is bound to.

id.description: The first 16 hex digits of the token's SHA-256.

routes.description: The gateway routes it may use.

run.description: The run it was issued to.

field.description: The params field (or request member) at fault.

help.description: What to change in the request.

kind.description: Stable name of the error code, for example invalid_params.

request_id.description: Correlation id for an internal error; the daemon's log has the details.
